title: C20 Deployment & runtime model (alternate config variants, no canonical edit)

files_forbidden: all app/(challenges)/* directories not belonging to this task

acceptance_criteria: The canonical next.config.ts is NOT modified; instead alternate, clearly-named variants are provided under solutions/c20-deployment/: next.config.export.ts (output:'export') and next.config.standalone.ts (standalone for Docker), each as a standalone reference artifact.
NOTES.md documents exactly what breaks under output:'export' (no ISR, no Route Handlers, no Server Actions, no on-demand revalidation) so the reader understands the static-export tradeoff.

runtime-map.md maps each representative route's rendering choice (SSG/ISR/SSR/PPR/Edge) to where it runs (build, serverless, edge) and notes that ISR / cacheComponents are resolved at the infra level.
The Dockerfile is consistent with the standalone variant and documents the build/run steps for a containerised deployment.

The c20 _meta folder contains spec.md (non-empty acceptance criteria), defend-it.md (3-5 from-memory questions with model answers), verification.md, and a discoverable challenge.config.ts. NOTE (independence): this task intentionally only DESCRIBES alternate configs as reference artifacts and must not touch the canonical next.config.ts.
output_format: code plus plain English explanation of every non-obvious decision
